description: Injected failure drill: org.aineko.goms-distillation-workers removed via launchctl bootout, then recovered via bootstrap + kickstart and verified running. Exercises the documented launchd recovery order end-to-end without touching the GOMS MCP server or the Hermes gateway.

steps.description: Guard: the LaunchAgent plist exists so recovery is possible; capture current service state as evidence
Failure injection: bootout the service; confirm absence (drill step must not fail the run)
command: launchctl bootout gui/$(id -u)/org.aineko.goms-distillation-workers 2>&1 || true; launchctl print gui/$(id -u)/org.aineko.goms-distillation-workers 2>&1 | head -2; true

steps.description: Assert the service is genuinely gone before recovery (negated probe)
Recovery: bootstrap the service back from its plist
Verification: service registered and holding a live pid
command: sleep 2; launchctl print gui/$(id -u)/org.aineko.goms-distillation-workers | grep -q 'pid = ' && launchctl list | grep -q org.aineko.goms-distillation-workers
